narrative.overview: Use Quickpeek’s native KDE visual language with persistent store navigation. Native Qt Widgets and KDE Frameworks provide the controls and embedded operation terminal. Inherit the desktop's font family, colors, icon theme, and control style.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent navigation beside scrollable software discovery.
Bundled application icons and publisher screenshots in the offline Explore prototype.
Native dialogs and package-manager prompts inside one window.

rules.name: The Theme Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Resolve shell and text colors from QPalette and preserve system light and dark themes. Fixed category colors are limited to Explore category controls and tile washes.

rules.name: The System Font Rule
rules.body: Preserve the desktop family and native control typography when extending the app.

dos: Do inherit the desktop palette, font family, control style, and icons.
Do keep software sources explicit on operational Installed rows and prototype source controls.
Do use metadata-backed icons and publisher screenshots with recorded origins; label Explore as an offline sample prototype.
Do keep details and confirmations explicit before package operations.
Do preserve shared list insets and filled discovery bands with publisher-screenshot spotlights at narrow desktop sizes.
donts: Don't invent ratings, safety badges, or publisher screenshots. AI-generated images are permitted only for design mockups, never as application assets.
Don't replace native controls with a web imitation or ship the structural reference as artwork.
Don't override the user's configured icon theme; Breeze is the fallback.
Don't describe AUR review or AppImage import as safety certification.
Don't treat a source-code correction as a completed visual review.
